messages:
Sofia: Quick async check-in for today — please drop a 1-line update: yesterday / blocker / today. Flag any reviews, cross-team asks, or playbook run-throughs. I'll collate. :clipboard:

Nina: Yesterday: finished integration tests for shard-routing. Blocker: intermittent KV-cache evictions causing perf flakiness (seen on staging node3). Today: debugging with @Ravi and will open a mitigation PR. cc @Marta. :eyes:

Ravi: I pulled logs overnight — noisy GC spikes on node3 around 02:12 UTC. Trying kernel oom_adj and tuning JVM flags in dev. No blocker for deploy but will follow up. :mag:

Marta: Pager quiet overnight. Updated canary rollback playbook with the new alert thresholds. Ask: need a volunteer to run a live playbook run-through Thu 11:00am UTC — who can join? :raised_hand:

Jess: Yesterday: aligned with sales on Dedicated demo script and updated the runbook. Ask: engineering to provide a one-slide latency/throughput snapshot (p50/p95 token latency + qps) for the demo by EOD. @Sofia any preference on numbers? :speech_balloon:

Liam: Pushed a tiny console polish (button spacing). Will prepare a short 20–30s capture for docs. @Nina can you grab the video when you exercise the flow? :camera:

deploy-bot: Deploy started to staging — redwood-runtime v1.18.2 — id: deploy-stg-1794008000. :rocket:

Sofia: Thanks all. I can pull the latency numbers for Jess — will share in this thread in an hour. Marta I can run Thu 11:00am playbook. @everyone: tag a message with the word "blocker" if something is actually blocking release so we can triage immediately. :white_check_mark:

Nina: PR #4826 is ready for review — routing config change + tests. @Ravi @Sofia please review when you have a moment. Small risk but improves cache warming.

Ravi: Reviewing PR #4826 now, will leave inline comments. If all good I'll approve tonight.

Marta: If anyone wants to sanity-check the rollback flow before Thu, I can walk through it in a quick call today at 4pm UTC — reply here if you'd like to join. :calendar:

Sofia: Awesome. I'll post the latency slide update shortly. Anything else? If not, great work — keep tagging asks in this thread so I can compile for the all-hands notes. :sparkles:
